artifact_name: Leônidas — Adaptive AI Workstation UI Specification

supersedes.policy: Preserva a linguagem visual do rascunho, substitui conteúdo fictício por contratos reais do Leônidas e adiciona arquitetura mobile/Capacitor.

executive_decisions.decision: Renomear integralmente a experiência visual para Leônidas.
executive_decisions.reason: Live Commentator é origem conceitual; o produto atual possui aplicação, runtime e ciclo de vida próprios.

executive_decisions.decision: Manter Vite + TypeScript sem introduzir React nesta etapa.
executive_decisions.reason: A WebUI atual é frameworkless e a mudança solicitada é prioritariamente visual. Uma migração de framework aumentaria risco sem benefício imediato.

executive_decisions.decision: Organizar a interface em três espaços reais: Operação, Configuração e Diagnóstico.
executive_decisions.reason: Evita criar rotas fictícias para ferramentas, extensões, analytics ou sessões ainda não implementadas.

executive_decisions.decision: Usar o cockpit de duas colunas apenas no modo Operação.
executive_decisions.reason: Visão/áudio e conversa precisam permanecer simultaneamente visíveis no desktop; configuração e logs não precisam competir por espaço o tempo todo.

executive_decisions.decision: Tratar capabilities do backend como autoridade de visibilidade.
executive_decisions.reason: Campos incompatíveis devem desaparecer; câmera/tela devem ser bloqueadas na cascata local com explicação explícita.

executive_decisions.decision: Separar mobile web responsivo, shell Capacitor e integrações nativas.
executive_decisions.reason: Botões físicos, assistente global, captura de tela do sistema e execução em segundo plano não são capacidades puramente visuais ou do WebView.

executive_decisions.decision: Não prometer conexão móvel real com o backend atual como mudança somente de UI.
executive_decisions.reason: O backend atual é local-only em 127.0.0.1; no celular, localhost aponta para o próprio aparelho.

already_exists_and_must_be_exposed: modelos Gemini 2.5 e 3.1 declarados por capabilities
Parakeet, Groq GPT-OSS e XTTS na cascata
estado e readiness de recursos locais STT/TTS
configuração ativa e draft com revision/dirty_fields
métricas TTFA, startup, frames, chunks, VAD e interrupções
logs ao vivo via SSE e arquivos paginados
not_currently_implemented_and_must_not_b: gerenciamento visual de múltiplas sessões simultâneas
ações rápidas como resumir tela, OCR, detectar UI, traduzir
captura nativa da tela do sistema pelo WebView
conexão remota segura do celular ao backend desktop
project_alignment.compatibility_rule: Elementos futuros só aparecem quando um capability flag ou endpoint real os anunciar.

design_intent.summary: Cockpit técnico escuro e preciso, inspirado no rascunho tático amarelo-lima, mas com hierarquia operacional, estados reais e comportamento adaptativo.

visual_principles.name: Estado antes de decoração
visual_principles.description: Conexão, sessão, agente, captura e recursos locais devem ser reconhecidos em menos de dois segundos.

visual_principles.name: Lima é intenção
visual_principles.description: O acento amarelo-lima representa foco, seleção e ação primária, não todos os estados positivos.

visual_principles.name: Painéis respiram
visual_principles.description: A estética técnica usa grade, divisores e corner accents, mas raios e espaçamentos permanecem compatíveis com toque e leitura.

visual_principles.name: Capabilities moldam a tela
visual_principles.description: A interface não oferece controles incompatíveis e sempre explica indisponibilidade de visão na cascata.

visual_principles.name: Desktop é cockpit; mobile é controle de campo
visual_principles.description: O celular prioriza conversa, captura e sessão; logs e configuração avançada ficam em telas dedicadas.

display.delivery: bundled optional; never depend on remote CDN

motion.reduce_motion: remove pulses, transform transitions and animated graph interpolation

application_shell.behavior: 100dvh, sem scroll da página no modo Operação; painéis internos rolam.

optional_future_zone.purpose: tool calls, subagents and memory events after real contracts exist

rules: Changing a field only updates draft.
Apply is explicit.
Apply & Restart requires confirmation while running.
Unsupported fields are absent.
Cascade hides vision controls and explains why.
No separate prepare/unload buttons for local models.

top.preview_pip: shown only while camera/screen is active

bottom_composer.attachments_button: opens camera/screen/file options allowed by capabilities
bottom_composer.keyboard_behavior: Enter sends only when hardware keyboard; mobile uses explicit send

perception_screen.cascade_behavior: show explanatory empty state; keep microphone available

settings_screen.save_pattern: sticky draft bar with Apply; Apply & Restart while running

mobile_diagnostics.logs: dedicated full-screen viewer, paused by default when app is backgrounded

responsive_rules.behavior: mobile shell, bottom navigation, one screen at a time
tablet shell; conversation and perception can split in landscape
compact desktop; icon rail and operation split

visual_concept.presentation: native bottom sheet/voice interaction layer, not a DOM modal
visual_concept.background: near-black translucent surface with lime edge

primary_actions.label: Conversar agora
primary_actions.behavior: open or resume native voice session

target_approach: request ROLE_ASSISTANT with explicit user consent
bridge session state to Capacitor app
run mediaProjection foreground service while sharing
run microphone foreground service only when platform rules allow
android.power_button_behavior: Possible only when Leônidas is the selected assistant and the OEM/system maps long-press power to the assistant. Do not intercept KEYCODE_POWER directly.
android.screen_capture_behavior: Every projection session requires visible system consent; the app cannot silently start capture.
fallback_entry_points: in-app floating control while session is active
android.oem_variability: Treat power-button launch as capability-detected, not guaranteed.

target_approach: Action Button shortcut on supported iPhones
Control Center control or Lock Screen widget
ScreenCaptureKit where supported; ReplayKit fallback for older deployment targets if required
ios.side_button_behavior: General replacement of the iPhone side button is not available to arbitrary apps. The special conversational side-button path is region/entitlement constrained.
ios.screen_capture_behavior: Use system selection/permission UI; never present capture as silent.

web_fallback.behavior: show in-app quick sheet only while the Capacitor activity/WebView is foregrounded
limitations: cannot keep unrestricted microphone access in background

mobile_runtime_architecture.critical_constraint: The current backend binds to 127.0.0.1. A physical phone cannot reach the desktop backend through its own localhost.

supported_architecture_options.name: Desktop host + mobile remote client
requires: TLS or mutually authenticated secure tunnel
configurable REST and WebSocket base URLs
single media owner arbitration across clients

supported_architecture_options.name: Backend embedded on mobile
requires: port or replacement of Python runtime

supported_architecture_options.name: Mobile UI prototype with mocks
requires: no claim of real remote session
supported_architecture_options.impact: UI-only and suitable for design validation

phase_1_no_framework.principle: Retain vanilla TypeScript and split the current monolithic class by responsibility.

native_plugins.name: LeonidasScreenCapture
responsibilities: deliver encoded frames or video frames

dom_compatibility_map.strategy: Preserve existing IDs in Phase 1 so visual restructuring does not break main.ts.

session: Start requires WebSocket connected and state stopped/error.
configuration: Every change writes only to draft.
Apply while running becomes Apply & Restart and confirms impact.
Revision conflict reloads the latest config and preserves an accessible error.
capture: Camera and screen are mutually exclusive.
Capture may remain locally active while session is stopped, but media is not sent.
When vision capability is false, camera/screen are unavailable and explained.
conversation: Intermediate transcription updates the same row.
Final transcript becomes a stable item.
Desktop Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line.
Mobile always exposes a visible Send action.
logs: Pause stops ingestion into the visual buffer rather than accumulating hidden lines.

rules: All status colors include icon and text.
Visible focus ring is 2px lime with 2px offset.
All icon-only controls have accessible labels.
Touch targets are at least 44px on mobile.
aria-live polite is used for routine session/agent changes.
aria-live assertive is reserved for critical failure.
Dialogs trap and restore focus.
Reduced motion disables pulse and animated transitions.
Charts have textual summaries.
Logs and conversations do not steal focus on autoscroll.
Do not render video frames through DOM updates.
Keep frame capture outside reactive render loops.
Batch SSE log rendering.
Virtualize only after profiling; preserve 2000-line hard limit.
Pause or slow metrics polling when document is hidden.
Use CSS grid texture instead of bitmap.
Use SVG for small charts and HUD.
Do not load local model resource panels when Gemini is selected beyond the single existing snapshot.

implementation_plan.name: Contract freeze and visual inventory
scope: add screenshot fixtures for all session/capture/resource states

implementation_plan.name: Desktop visual refactor
scope: preserve existing IDs and API calls
replace rounded green visual with tactical lime design

implementation_plan.name: iOS quick entry and capture
scope: Action Button and Control Center entry points

desktop_ui_only: All current controls remain functional without backend contract changes.
Every canonical session state is visually reproducible.
Cascade local hides visual controls and exposes STT/TTS readiness.
The page does not scroll in 1600x900 Operation view.
Configuration and diagnostics remain keyboard accessible.
No fictitious route or action appears as functional.
responsive_mobile: All primary tasks are usable at 360px width.
Conversation is reachable in one tap after launch.
Start/Stop is always reachable in at most two taps.
Active camera/screen preview can collapse to PiP.
Draft changes remain visible and require explicit Apply.
android_native: Assistant-role setup is explicit and reversible.
Power-button launch is advertised only when the system reports support/configuration.
Screen capture always shows system consent.
Foreground-service notification remains visible during capture.
Stopping projection releases all native surfaces and media tracks.
ios_native: No claim is made that the standard side button can be universally replaced.
Action Button/App Shortcut entry points work on supported devices.
Screen capture uses system permission/selection UI.
Background and audio-session failures are visible and recoverable.
security: No API key or protected prompt enters the web bundle.
Mobile remote access is unavailable until authenticated encryption exists.
Logs do not expose media, transcripts, objective or credentials.
A second media client cannot silently seize the active session.

open_questions.question: O aplicativo mobile será um controle remoto do Leônidas rodando no computador ou deverá executar um runtime próprio no telefone?
Android será a plataforma prioritária para a experiência de botão físico/assistente?
O usuário aceitará configurar Leônidas como assistente padrão no Android?
A primeira versão mobile precisa transmitir a tela inteira ou apenas o app selecionado?
O overlay rápido deve iniciar uma sessão automaticamente ou exigir um segundo toque explícito?
As futuras quick actions serão comandos locais da UI, tools do agente ou prompts predefinidos?
